scope: Assigned frozen titles and complete ItemBodies, local rendered HTML, and every assigned screenshot tile; no live routes.

review_method.normative_instructions: CLAUDE.md read fully; README.md read fully; SCHEMA.md and WORKFLOW.md read for repository and rendering-audit context.
review_method.rendering: Every assigned local PNG tile was opened individually with tools.view_image at original resolution; no collage or downscaling.
review_method.source_snapshot_html: Every assigned frozen title and full ItemBody was reviewed in the snapshot and matching local HTML; snapshot/current source, HTML, capture receipt and PNG hashes were checked against the assignment/receipt.
review_method.boundary: No item, application, or publication-status edits; no builds, tests, gates, commits, pushes, or network calls. Only lane-05.md and lane-05.json were written.

diagram_candidates.rationale: The definition introduces Young diagrams as the node sets [λ] and conjugation as the coordinate transpose; a small diagram pair makes the row/column convention and conjugate shape immediately legible.
diagram_candidates.concrete_maps_or_relations: Use λ=(3,1), λ′=(2,1,1); draw nodes in English orientation and label transpose (i,j)↦(j,i), with row lengths (3,1) becoming column heights (2,1,1).

diagram_candidates.rationale: The definition names the bumping route and new box; their evolving positions are inherently spatial and are difficult to reconstruct from the procedural prose alone.
diagram_candidates.concrete_maps_or_relations: Illustrate T with rows [1,3,5] / [2,4], insert x=2.5, bump 3 from row 1 column 2, then 4 from row 2 column 2, and append 4 in row 3 column 1; route (2,2,1), new box (3,1), bumped values 2.5<3<4.

diagram_candidates.rationale: The main assertion is an explicit bijection between hooks represented by same-runner bead-gap pairs and quotient hooks; the abacus rescaling is the core mathematical map and benefits from a compact runner diagram.
diagram_candidates.concrete_maps_or_relations: For runner i, show b=b′e+i and g=g′e+i mapping to quotient pair (b′,g′); label |H|=b−g=e(b′−g′)=e|f(H)| and Q_e(λ\H)=Q_e(λ)\f(H). Keep the diagram explanatory; proof remains textual.
